upstream.description: An interactive tool that transforms static system design diagrams into explorable, interactive visualizations using AI.

classification.analysis: System Design Visualizer is a React/Vite web app that turns a static system-design image (architecture diagram, flowchart) into an interactive, explorable graph: it uses OpenAI GPT-4o vision to convert the uploaded image into an editable Mermaid.js diagram, then renders it as a React Flow graph where clicking a node (load balancer, database, etc.) surfaces AI-inferred details like tech stack and role. It targets engineers and architects who want to explore or document existing system diagrams interactively rather than as flat images, and includes a mock mode that works without an OpenAI API key. Development has been quiet since its initial release in December 2025.
